info.name: Dentax API - DentalBox Clinical Management System
info.description:
Complete, production-grade Postman collection for the Dentax (DentalBox / MediBook) backend REST API.

### Authentication
- Authenticated requests use JWT Bearer Tokens in the `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` header.
- The login and register requests automatically capture `token` into the environment variable `{{accessToken}}`.

### Base URL
Configured as `{{baseUrl}}` (defaults to `http://localhost:5000`).

### Modules Included
1. System & Health Check
2. Authentication & Clinic Profile
3. Dashboard & Global Search
4. Patient Management
5. Appointments & Scheduling
6. Patient Clinical Visits
7. Billing & Invoices (Standard & Quick Bill)
8. E-Prescriptions
9. Accounts & Financials (Income & Expense)
10. Campaigns & Marketing (SMS/Email/WhatsApp with upload)
11. Inventory, Stock Movements & Purchase Orders
12. Dental Lab Work Orders
13. Reports & Clinical Analytics
14. Subscriptions & Tier Activation
